Family Favorites.notes: Family-friendly recipes should span baby, tiffin, snack and protein use cases.

Healthy Living.notes: Healthy collections should show protein, lighter meals and practical quick options.

Everyday Cooking.notes: Everyday utility can be large if recipes are genuinely useful daily staples.

Regional Journeys.notes: Do not penalize large totals when recipes are regionally meaningful.

Kitchen Essentials.notes: Foundation collections should cover sides, condiments and meal-completing add-ons.

Seasonal Specials.notes: Seasonal content should be tightly relevant to weather or season.

Celebrations & Traditions.notes: Festival and tradition collections may be large when occasion coverage is strong.

Global Bites.notes: Global discovery should show cuisine variety, not just one format.

Family Favorites::Lunch Box & Tiffin.notes: A strong tiffin collection needs morning wins, protein and after-school snacks.

Healthy Living::Healthy Plates.notes: Protein mains can lead, but light bowls and quick healthy options must be visible.

Everyday Cooking::Daily Comforts.notes: Breakfast and rice-dal anchors can be larger, but dinner utility should not disappear.

Regional Journeys::Karnataka.notes: Large Karnataka coverage is acceptable when the recipes are specific and authentic.

Regional Journeys::Kerala.notes: Kerala coverage can lean breakfast-heavy while authentic curries and sides grow.

Regional Journeys::Northeast.notes: Northeast coverage should prioritize regional identity over artificial balance.

Regional Journeys::Jammu & Kashmir.notes: Current coverage is weak because explicit Kashmiri/Jammu recipes are not present.

Kitchen Essentials::Sides, Salads & Add-.notes: Large count is acceptable if sides, cooling sides, salads and add-ons are split clearly.

Celebrations & Traditions::Festival Swee.notes: Festival sweets can be much larger than other celebration subcategories.

Global Bites::Global Bowls.notes: Global bowls should include rice, noodle, protein and vegetarian variety.
